name: DeepSeek Web
description: Real-time web search and URL content extraction powered by DeepSeek's Search & Fetch APIs.
author: Readon
safetyNotes: Makes authenticated HTTPS calls to api.deepseek.com using your existing DeepSeek API key, resolved from pi's model registry, the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable, or ~/.pi/agent/auth.json. No key is bundled in the package and none is sent anywhere except the DeepSeek API.

zh-CN.name: DeepSeek 联网搜索
zh-CN.description: 基于 DeepSeek Search 与 Fetch API 的实时网络搜索与网页正文抽取工具，为智能体提供联网能力。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 使用你已有的 DeepSeek API Key（依次从 pi 模型注册表、DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 环境变量、~/.pi/agent/auth.json 解析）向 api.deepseek.com 发起认证 HTTPS 请求。包内不捆绑任何密钥，除 DeepSeek API 外不会把密钥发送到别处。

changelog: Docs + tooling only (no runtime code change): PI-Desktop enable/disable troubleshooting (host registry state, session tool snapshot, post-update resets) and scripts/sync-to-pi-desktop.ps1 to sync the repo into the installed snapshot copy.
